positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCadenceAndOwnership
positions.frame: What cadence and operational accountability govern Atlas rollback rehearsals?
positions.why: Quinton's directive mandating monthly rollback drills and establishing the core principle that unrehearsed rollbacks do not exist (src-1) coheres directly with the documented operational record fixing the monthly cadence (src-2) and assigning explicit ownership to Quinton (src-3).
